name: eeprom_process
purpose: Advance the VBLANK counter and process at most one verification/write step or one queued asynchronous read
exceptional_convention: normal stack ABI; serializes EEPROM writes through unlock register 0x803150

name: eeprom_init
purpose: Validate the game hook, allocate the difficulty-sized configuration image on the caller stack, load/check/correct redundant EEPROM blocks, and queue repairs
return: D0.l = 0 initialized, 1 invalid game-hook header, or -1 on terminal initialization/error-state exit
exceptional_convention: nonstandard persistent stack allocation: removes the return address, reserves the configuration image, then restores the return address below it

name: eeprom_decode_block
purpose: Select a ten-byte destination from A2/D3 and decode one thirty-byte redundant EEPROM block with syndrome correction
arguments: A2 = configuration image; A3 = EEPROM base; D2 = physical block; D3 = destination record
return: D0.l = 0 clean, positive for a correctable syndrome, negative for uncorrectable syndrome; D2 and D3 increment
exceptional_convention: register-only internal entry; falls into 0x467C shared decoder

name: eeprom_decode_block_to
purpose: Decode one thirty-byte redundant EEPROM block into an explicitly supplied ten-byte destination
arguments: A1 = destination; A2 = configuration image/error counter context; A3 = EEPROM base; D2 = physical block; D3 = record counter
return: D0.l = 0 clean, positive for a correctable syndrome, negative for uncorrectable syndrome; D2 and D3 increment
exceptional_convention: register-only shared entry used by synchronous reads

name: eeprom_clear_statistics
purpose: Clear the 200-byte high-score/statistics area and queue EEPROM regions 4-11
exceptional_convention: register-only initialization helper; tail-enters shared request-bitmap update

name: eeprom_clear_configuration
purpose: Clear configuration bytes 0-9, 16-18, and 20-29 and queue EEPROM regions 0-2
exceptional_convention: register-only initialization helper; tail-enters shared request-bitmap update

name: eeprom_request_write
purpose: Queue one logical EEPROM region by setting its request-bitmap bit
exceptional_convention: normal stack veneer over 0x47AC register entry

name: eeprom_request_write_register
purpose: Queue one logical EEPROM region already selected in D0

name: eeprom_clear_difficulty_rows
purpose: Clear all allocated difficulty histogram rows and queue their logical EEPROM regions
exceptional_convention: register-only initialization helper; returns immediately when difficulty is zero, otherwise tail-enters shared request-bitmap update

name: eeprom_check_busy
purpose: Test the write bitmap, asynchronous-read ring, and active byte-write pointer
return: D0.l = 1 when any EEPROM work is pending, 0 when idle

name: eeprom_read_block
purpose: Read and verify a logical EEPROM block synchronously or enqueue an asynchronous read
arguments: destination pointer; logical block index word; mode long (zero synchronous, nonzero queued)
return: D0.l = 1 success/queued, 0 invalid/busy/full; synchronous decode also returns -1 correctable syndrome or -2 uncorrectable syndrome
